title: Treaty of the Pyrenees
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of the Pyrenees", at revision 1378429109, opens: "The Treaty of the Pyrenees was signed on 7 November 1659 and ended the Franco–Spanish War that had begun in 1635." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q221670, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1659 border treaty between France and Spain". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
